name: wikiweigher
description: Ranks the same Wikipedia article across languages by prose depth (excluding references) and number of references, and recommends the best one to read.

scripts.test:unit: node --test test/rate.test.js test/rateBanner.test.js test/wordcount.test.js test/scorer.test.js test/verbosity.test.js test/prose.test.js test/wikidata.test.js test/languageIndex.test.js test/cache.test.js test/schema.test.js test/settings.test.js test/layout.test.js test/migrate.test.js test/articleContext.test.js test/depthAnalyzer.test.js test/model.test.js test/card.test.js test/cardError.test.js test/diagnostics.test.js test/report.test.js test/locales.test.js
scripts.shots:welcome: node pptr-welcomeshots.mjs && node scripts/frame-shots.mjs && node scripts/optimise-shots.mjs
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir firefox
